exposure: Resuscitation with 100% oxygen during physiological based cord clamping (PBCC)
Resuscitation with 100% oxygen after immediate cord clamping (ICC)
cohort: The study participants were instrumented, steroid-exposed preterm lambs (125 +- 1 days' gestation).
finding: Physiological based cord clamping (PBCC) with prolonged high oxygen resuscitation prevents initial hypoxia and subsequent hyperoxia but does not reduce lung oxidative stress, inflammation, or injury compared to immediate cord clamping (ICC) with the same resuscitation in preterm lambs.
